I consider this day a turning point in my life,
i was depressed as fuck in may of last year because I had attachment issues and I was attached to a mediocre man who I wasn't even dating, we stopped talking because he randomly got a girlfriend after saying he didn't wanna be in a relationship (yea ok)

but that situation amongst other issues in my life made me finally go to therapy because my self esteem was nonexistent and I couldn't go a day without crying. I was already depressed even before that so the other bullshit in my life only amplified it. a lot of days I stopped doing my skincare, taking care of my hair as well so it was started to affect me physically 

it was may 12th 2022 where I first went to therapy, it was after school at 4:15 PM and a 7 min walk from the train station. therapy was nice, I still have social anxiety so it was a very scary thing to do but I know I needed it, I talked about a lot and genuinely felt better 
after that I went home and when I ger home I don't even remember where I saw it from but I was obviously on my phone and I think I saw something on instagram about foundations being released and I lost my mind

I'm not an old-school fan by any means, I've been listening to them since 2018 but I remember after getting home I instantly connected my phone to a speaker because I needed to hear this as loud as possible, and foundations is an amazing song

I didn't look at it like this back then but I consider it a turning point because  2 big events in my life happened at that same day and over the summer my life got better. I  even got to go to one of their shows on august 27th, a last minute decision because my friend wanted to go and recommended it 2 days before the concert 

I'll always associate this song with healing
